tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Searches the library by meaning. Returns ranked passage snippets (the ref and its first ~180 characters) with links. Snippets are short excerpts, not full passages. Optional hebrew_terms rank passages that contain those Hebrew words higher.

tools.name: fetch_text
tools.description: Returns the full Hebrew and English text of one canonical ref, or of up to 10 refs, with links. A range such as 'Shabbat 21b:5-11' works. Text is cut at about 3000 characters per language for one ref (1500 when several are read) and marked [TRUNCATED].

tools.name: fetch_commentary
tools.description: Returns the commentary on a verse or passage (Rashi, Ramban, Ibn Ezra, Sforno and others), in each commentator's own words, with links. Can be limited to named commentators.

tools.name: resolve_ref
tools.description: Turns a natural-language reference ('Rambam Teshuvah 2', 'Hilchot Shabbat ch. 5') into the library's canonical ref, or returns suggested completions.
